d: marker pointing to information that needs to be considered in addition to previous information (either explicit or implied)
literally: to add (an activity to one's activities); hence: = action by which humans add additional activities to those that they are currently engaged in

a marker indicating that what follows needs to be considered in addition to what was said before (either explicitly or implied), and also often confirming that this new information is more conclusive or compelling than the information preceding it
